content.text: API documentation refers to the process of providing comprehensive details about how a RESTful API works. This includes:

sections.heading: Why Do We Need API Documentation?

items: For Developers: Helps frontend/backend teams understand how to interact with the API.
For Testers: Provides clarity for test case preparation.
For Consumers: Enables external users or integrators to use the API correctly.
For Maintenance: Serves as a reliable reference during updates and debugging.

content.text: Spring REST Docs is a tool that automatically generates accurate, up-to-date documentation for RESTful services based on your integration tests.

items: Produces code snippets for requests and responses.

sections.heading: Purpose of Using Spring REST Docs

items: Ensures the documentation is in sync with the actual implementation.
Automates documentation as part of the CI/CD pipeline.
Maintains tight integration with test cases.
Allows for documentation of headers, parameters, errors, etc.
Write Integration Tests using Spring MockMvc.
Use snippets to document requests, responses, headers, etc.
Generate Asciidoctor documentation from the tests.
